name: Globaliser
author: Globaliser, Inc.

sections.description:
This plugin enables Globaliser Cloud’s Speed, Security, and Reliability features for WordPress sites, ensuring optimal performance for Globaliser clients. This plugin is an integration layer that communicates site changes to the Globaliser Cloud Endpoints, where our caching, CDN, DNS, and security services optimize site performance and security.

Important Note: This plugin is currently intended for Globaliser clients only and does not require any settings or configuration by the end user. Our system automatically detects necessary changes and configurations remotely, so no additional action is required after installation.

Usage Instructions

1.  Install and Activate: Install and activate the plugin on the WordPress site.
2.  Verification: Upon activation, the plugin will immediately start tracking specific hooks related to content changes and send data to the Globaliser backend via a secure API endpoint.
3.  No User Configuration Required: This plugin has been designed for zero-configuration usage. All necessary configurations are managed by Globaliser support staff as needed for client accounts. Future updates may introduce configurable options, which will be accessible in the WordPress admin panel.
4.  Testing the Connection: If you’d like to test the plugin’s functionality, you can:
•   Verify Database Entries: The plugin logs changes in a specific database table, which can be confirmed through the site’s database.
•   Check API Responses: When a tracked action (such as a new post) is performed, it sends data to the Globaliser backend. Successful API responses can be viewed in the site’s debug logs if enabled.

Troubleshooting:
Since the plugin has no configurable settings, it should work seamlessly upon activation for Globaliser clients. If any issues arise, clients should contact Globaliser support for assistance.
sections.installation:
Manual Installation

  1. Unzip and upload the globaliser folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the Globaliser plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
